name: Kawamoto (Shimane, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kawamoto town emblem in white: a ring enclosing three vertical bars, like the character 川.
history: Municipal flag of Kawamoto, a town in Shimane Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 8 April 1965.

features.role: Kawamoto town emblem — a ring enclosing three vertical bars, like the character 川
